---
name: curation-entry
description: Add a public API or integration reference to Ventura APIs with purpose authentication model and canonical documentation identified. Use when extending the API curation. Do not use when implementing an API client inside another repository.
---

# Curation entry

- Verify the API and canonical documentation exist.
- Record its primary use case and required authentication at a high level.
- Note material usage limits or access constraints when documented.
- Avoid duplicate providers or aliases already listed.
- Do not imply endorsement availability or free access beyond source evidence.
- Keep examples free of real credentials.
